name: Twofer
headline: Good things, closer to home.
tagline: Find a local deal. Make someone's day.
summary: Discover live offers from nearby cafés, bakeries, restaurants, and shops. Claim a deal and redeem it in person.
description: A coffee stop, a neighborhood favorite, a reason to try somewhere new. Twofer connects nearby customers with limited-time offers from local businesses. Merchants choose what to offer, when it runs, and how many people can claim it.
features: Discover what's nearby
Browse local offers by distance or ending time. Choose your area with location or a ZIP code.
Claim, then enjoy
Save an offer and show its QR or claim code to the business when you visit.
Built for local businesses
Create offers, set availability, and redeem claims at the counter. Visit Twofer for merchant information.
note: Local offers depend on participating businesses and availability. Twofer's merchant pilot is focused on Irving, Coppell, Grapevine, and Carrollton.
supportSummary: Help with your account, offers, claims, or merchant setup.
screenAlts: A claimed offer and redemption code in Twofer

name: Sightlines
headline: Follow your curiosity.
tagline: Point your phone. Explore what's ahead.
summary: Explore likely addresses, roads, and geographic features in the direction you're facing, with Nearby, Night Mode, and World Line.
description: Ever wonder what lies in that direction? Sightlines pairs your phone's location and compass with a map you can explore. Adjust the distance and angle, discover nearby candidates, or follow World Line toward places farther away.
features: Explore nearby
Use a map cone to find likely addresses and roads. Results include confidence information so you can understand their limits.
Look a little farther
World Line explores cities, countries, oceans, and landmarks with a bundled geographic dataset available offline.
Keep your discoveries
Revisit saved reports on your device, or use Night Mode's low-light interface for a fresh cloud scan.
note: Includes three successful cloud scans before purchase. Sightlines Plus is $19.99/year in the U.S. for 100 fresh cloud scans per subscription year and renews automatically unless canceled. Local pricing is shown in the app. Saved history and offline World Line remain available without Plus. Sightlines is for discovery, not emergency response or navigation.
supportSummary: Help with location, cloud scans, saved history, or your Plus subscription.
screenAlts: Sightlines Nearby map and direction cone

name: Penguin Bounce
headline: A little bounce. A big rescue.
tagline: Break the ice. Bring a friend home.
summary: Guide an ice board, bounce a snowball, and rescue penguin friends as the tides change around you.
description: An arctic cove, a trusty snowball, and a friend who needs a hand. Find a path through ice and rocks in an endless arcade rescue game with fresh formations every run.
features: Find your next rescue
New ice formations, rescue pockets, and rock layouts make each run a little different.
Watch the tides
Rising and falling water changes which rocks block your snowball. Time your shots as the route shifts.
Make it your moment
Chase your best score, pause when you need to, and choose your sound and haptic settings. No account needed.
note: Personal records stay on your device. Presented by Twofer, with an optional link to its separate local-deals app after a finished run.
supportSummary: Help with rescues, controls, game settings, or your saved records.
screenAlts: Penguin Bounce with a snowball in play
Penguin Bounce ready for a rescue

name: Penguin Slide
headline: Three shots. One perfect glide.
tagline: Find your angle. Chase a perfect 300.
summary: Pull back, aim, and slide toward the rings in a cozy three-shot shuffleboard game on the ice.
description: A gentle pull or a bold launch can make all the difference. Send your penguin across the floe and land as close to the center as you can. There's always room for one more try.
features: Simple touch controls
Pull back to choose your angle and power, then release to send your penguin gliding.
Three chances to shine
Land in the rings for 25, 50, or 100 points. Three perfect stops add up to 300.
A fresh challenge
Target positions change each run. Play offline, keep your personal best on your device, and adjust sound and haptics.
note: No account is needed. Presented by Twofer, with an optional link to its separate local-deals app after a finished run.
supportSummary: Help with aiming, scoring, sound, or your personal best.
screenAlts: Penguin Slide's first glide on the ice

name: Penguin Express
headline: Special delivery. Steady flippers.
tagline: Keep the coffee in the cup.
summary: Swipe across the ice, dodge snowbanks, and deliver as much coffee as you can in three quick runs.
description: Your customers are waiting, and the ice is slippery. Guide a determined penguin through three short deliveries while protecting a very important cup of coffee. Every sip that arrives counts.
features: Swipe and slide
One swipe changes one lane. Steer around snowbanks and rough ice on the way to your customer.
Make every sip count
Three deliveries bring different obstacle layouts. Keep the coffee steady and aim for a perfect 300.
Pick up and play
Play offline without an account. Your best score stays on your device, with optional sound and haptics.
note: Presented by Twofer. Exploring its separate local-deals app is optional and is not needed to play.
supportSummary: Help with deliveries, swipe controls, scoring, or game settings.

name: Penguin Crash
headline: The gulls took lunch. Take it back.
tagline: Launch the crew. Reclaim the fish.
summary: Launch three bold penguins, topple icy towers, and reclaim every fish stash across 30 physics puzzles.
description: Pull back, aim, and send your crew through ice, timber, and precarious fortresses. Find a weak support, start a chain reaction, and turn a well-timed shot into a very satisfying heist.
features: Three penguins, three tricks
Hop with Skipper, slam with Chonk, or time Puff's bounce to turn an awkward landing into a clever shot.
An arctic adventure
Solve 30 levels across Slippery Shores, Crooked Docks, and Freezer Fortress.
Make every shot better
Earn completion, par, and gold medals. Play offline, retry instantly, and adjust music, effects, haptics, and reduced motion.
note: For iPhone and iPad. Rated 13+ on the App Store for cartoon or fantasy violence. No accounts or in-app purchases. Presented by Twofer, with an optional link to its separate local-deals app.
supportSummary: Help with penguin abilities, levels, progress, or accessibility settings.
